B11:
Results were weighted by age group, gender, region, education level, ethnicity, recalled 2024 presidential vote, recalled 2020 presidential vote and media trust.

Population targets are derived from the United States Census Bureau. Media trust targets are derived from American National Election Study data, with a non-response bias model used to estimate proportions across the whole population, rather than just those who participated in the study.

B14: The Headline results tab gives the margin of error for each population, at 95% confidence, for a share of 50%. It uses the effective sample size, which takes account of weighting, so it is larger than a simple random sample of the same size would give. Margins for smaller subgroups in the Overall tab are wider.
